name: bbg-panel
author: SANDBAAD
description: BBG by SANDBAAD — multi-core (Xray / sing-box) VPN panel, with a Cloudflare Worker edition and a one-token installer

scripts.deploy:installer: node scripts/build-worker.mjs && cd installer && wrangler deploy

ADMIN_PASSWORD.description: Panel password, **10 characters or more**. You sign in as `admin` with it. رمز پنل، حداقل ۱۰ حرف.

ADMIN_PATH.description: Last part of the panel address: `https://<worker>.workers.dev/<ADMIN_PATH>/`. Letters, digits, `-` and `_`. Pick something hard to guess. بخش آخر آدرس پنل.
